description: The seven ticket summary and sibling reads enforce record policy and conceal missing and excluded tickets.
Ticket list and search use a shared compiled read policy to count and page visible tickets and comments with their live visibility rules.
Unsupported policies use batched records and the shared evaluator, and policy resolution failures deny affected matches.
Typeahead, full search and the shared API preserve authorized totals, stable public pagination and other object types in mixed results.
